The best education Richard Wolff got at Harvard, he told us, began when a man knocked on his dorm-room door. Fritz Pappenheim, a scholar who had served the Spanish Republican government during the civil war, had fled to France after Franco’s victory. Wolff’s father, an old friend, helped him get papers to stay in Paris and later a visa to come to the United States. Years later, Pappenheim found a way to repay him. He offered to teach his son to read Marx in German. The arrangement was simple. Every couple of weeks, the Harvard freshman would come over for dinner and French wine. articles.content_excerpt: In the first twenty-odd hours of playing Grand Theft Auto VI , the long-awaited latest installment in developer Rockstar’s open-world simulations of contemporary America, I chased a hovercraft with a helicopter, raced Jet Skis around a superyacht, and shot my way out of a hospital in a wheelchair — though not before spending all my stolen cash on medical bills. articles.title: The Socialist History Behind Thanksgiving’s Most Iconic Image
articles.author: Liza Featherstone
articles.content_excerpt: An older woman, still wearing her apron from all her work in the kitchen, brings a large turkey to a table set with cranberry sauce and fruit and full of family, friends, and neighbors, who are smiling, talking, enjoying one another’s company. Her husband stands beside her at the head of the table, surveying the scene with pride. The 1943 Norman Rockwell oil painting has become perhaps the most iconic and ubiquitous image of Thanksgiving in our modern era. It looks like a classic piece of kitschy, complacent Americana. Yet the image has a surprising political history. Nic salt offers can look deceptively simple: a multi-buy price, a percentage discount, perhaps a “buy three, get one free” message. Yet the cheapest-looking option is not always the best value—or even the right product for your device and preferences. That matters because nicotine salts are not interchangeable in the way many shoppers assume. Two bottles may have the same listed nicotine strength and flavour name, but differ in bottle size, VG/PG ratio, formula, coil compatibility, batch freshness, and the quality of information available before purchase. An initial public offering prospectus can look intimidating. Hundreds of pages may cover financial statements, risk factors, legal disclosures, ownership tables, executive compensation, and details about how shares will be sold. Yet investors do not need to memorize every line to understand what the document is trying to reveal. A disciplined reading process can separate the most decision-useful information from the boilerplate and help readers understand how a private company expects to operate under public-market scrutiny.
